lines: We use [information we collect](#1-WhatInformationDoWe) to provide a personalized experience to you, including ads, along with the other purposes we explain in detail below.

For some of these purposes, we use information [across our Products](https://mbasic.facebook.com/privacy/policy/printable/?annotations%5B0%5D=2.ex.5-UsingInformationAcrossOur&back_id=ref-21&entry=0) and [across your devices](https://mbasic.facebook.com/privacy/policy/printable/?annotations%5B0%5D=2.ex.1-WhyWeUseInformation&back_id=ref-22&entry=0). The information we use for these purposes is automatically processed by our systems. But in some cases, we also use [manual review](https://mbasic.facebook.com/privacy/policy/printable/?annotations%5B0%5D=2.ex.2-ManualReviewExamplesOf&back_id=ref-23&entry=0) to access and review your information.
